name: Calle Jorge: grass verges, hedge wall, benches, sign and lamp
trust: IMG_2182, IMG_2229 and IMG_2230 look along Calle Jorge: square terracotta between grass both sides, a white wall with a clipped hedge on the house side, and white scalloped benches on the lawn side. IMG_2231, IMG_2232 and IMG_2596 are that bench. The close-up pin is the station at 112 m along the mapped centreline; the other benches repeat that fitting every 16 m on the same lawn edge, which is what those lane views and the Apple Maps frames of the street show, and their exact gaps are estimated. Grass runs both sides of the 1.2 m path wherever a house does not occupy it. The hedge wall is the house-side boundary in those photos, continued along the open lane and stopped at buildings. IMG_2597 is the CALLE DE JORGE plinth and black lamp at the east end, 1.2 m off the opposite edge. Pins are ±2 to ±5 m.
